His father puts a candle inside the pumpkin.
Danny carries it over to the window.
He walks very, very carefully.
“Now light the candle,” he begs.
His father lights the candle inside the pumpkin.

“Hold it!” Danny’s father calls.
“We have something for you.”
He grabs a bowl from the table and goes out the door.
Danny watches from the window as his friends take candy from the bowl.
Then, “Good-bye!” they call.
“Wait!” Danny cries.
He puts on his own mask and puts his face near the window.
